name: ClonEval
description: We present a novel benchmark for voice cloning text-to-speech models. The benchmark consists of an evaluation protocol, an open-source library for assessing the performance of voice cloning models, and an accompanying leaderboard. The paper discusses design considerations and presents a detailed description of the evaluation procedure. The usage of the software library is explained, along with the organization of results on the leaderboard.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with an open-source evaluation library and leaderboard, so community adoption is still early and limited.
notes: New benchmark with limited public results; voice cloning evaluation is often subjective and can vary by protocol, so cross-paper comparability may be limited.
